falsifiable_hypothesis: The verified one-eighth contrast hedge is a safe global orientation-bias prior, while inner-fold EB reliability identifies targets where the contrast is reproducible enough to trust more strongly. Interpolating from the safe prior toward full correction according to reliability should reduce bias without reopening a strength grid.
component_rule: Orientation A is the leave-one-whole-patient bagged geometry prediction. Orientation B starts from interpolated-jackknife geometry. No A/B prediction averaging is performed.
calibration_rule: Within each outer-training partition compute cbar[t], v[t], tau2 and alpha[t] exactly as in eb_orientation_contrast_hedge from the authenticated three inner whole-patient folds. Define the correction reliability s[t]=1/8+(7/8)*alpha[t]. Apply q_B=q_B,interpolated_jackknife-0.5*s[t]*cbar[t]. Thus alpha=0 exactly recovers the previously verified one-eighth contrast prior, and alpha=1 recovers the full two-orientation contrast correction. There is no scalar tuning grid, held-fold outcome routing, or protected-data access.

task_contract.ab_rule: average separately costed A/B losses; never average predictions
